state:
Goal `core-test-2-2` is met. Every member in both `Core\Test` dossier checks has every proof. The last three were
`scriptAnswers`, `expectFailure` and `assertTrue`. Both `bun nv proofs --verify --only <check argv>` runs say
nothing owed, 0 failed. `bun nv verify --doc`, `bun nv owners --closes core-test-2-2` and `bun nv playbook --closes
core-test-2-2` are clean.

The `expectFailure` attack found two bugs, and both are fixed. Discharging the ledger was quadratic. A body that
caught its failure and then threw another error had that error swallowed. `Ctx::discharge_failures_from` now walks
only the entries after its mark. `Core\Test::expectFailure` now consumes only a pending `Core\Test\Failure`.
`tests/conformance/core/test-expect-failure-lets-an-error-after-a-caught-failure-propagate.nvst` pins it.

Every `Core\Test` bench was measured again after the last Rust change to `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/test.rs`.

items.text: **`Core\Test::scriptAnswers`, `Core\Test::expectFailure` and `Core\Test::assertTrue`** have every proof (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`); registry rows at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/test.rs:684`.

backlog: The ledger field doc says an assertion entry is "charged to the request". `record_assertion` pushes to a Rust `Vec` and charges no budget (not checked beyond `crates/nvs-runtime/src/ctx/error.rs:684`). A request that runs many `Core\Test` checks outside a test grows memory outside its cap. Owner: the `assertions` field doc in `crates/nvs-runtime/src/ctx/mod.rs`.
`Ctx::script_answers` copies every answer into a `VecDeque<String>` the budget does not see either; same owner question, `crates/nvs-runtime/src/ctx/wiring.rs:602`.
